mechanism: Epistemic {{reframe}}. Transforms assertions of '{{equivalence}}' (A == B means same meaning) into assertions of 'Divergence' (Hash(A) != Hash(B) means different meaning). This shifts the burden of proof from verifying universal truth to detecting local mismatch. It applies {{epistemic_calibrate}} to reduce the scope of assertions from 'Universal Truth' to 'Local Observation'.
failure_modes: Ontological Trap: Claiming the hash solves the Symbol Grounding {{problem}} (it doesn't).
Brittle Authority: Making absolute claims that invite refutation by a single edge case.
invariants: Epistemic Priority: Claims must describe 'Evidence of Divergence', not 'Proof of Meaning'.
Pragmatic Grounding: The measure of success is Coordination Utility, not Semantic Truth.
postconditions: Claim scope reduced to defensible limits (Epistemic/Utility)
